body: P2 finding: oversized raw goal evidence is treated as an ordinary rejected term, so later goal stages continue. If canonical raw evidence exceeds the 8 MiB limit, _proof_contract_route_context_evidence.store_goal_evidence raises ValueError (lines 22-23). Worker main catches it as status=rejected and exits 2 (worker lines 53-55, 78-81). Parent _admit_check recognizes only recursive resource codes or oversized returned envelope; this small rejection passes (route_context.py lines 102-109), then _check_goal returns True while leaving the goal unresolved (lines 85-96), allowing the loop at lines 65-69 to attempt later supplied goals. This conflicts with contract599 stop-later-stages on raw evidence capacity exhaustion. Pure reproduction of that exact worker rejection envelope through _admit_check returned True with no output-limit diagnostic. Recommended fix: emit a typed incomplete/output-limit worker result for raw evidence overflow and teach parent resource stop to halt it (or equivalent explicit bounded code preservation).
